messages:
incident-bot: Pager: GPU OOM during prefill on cluster-prod-us-west2. Pod inference-prod-7623 restarted 3x in 2m. Severity: P2. Auto-eviction triggered.
Alex R: grabbing pager. marking node gpu-usw2-17 drain -> cordon now :point_down:
Priya M: will pull runtime logs, likely large prefill from long context window. pinging if anyone saw customer tickets.
Priya M: logs snippet:
```
[2026-03-17 02:14:09] runtime.prefill ERROR: Prefill allocate failed: RuntimeError: CUDA out of memory. Tried to allocate 1.1 GiB (GPU 0; 16.00 GiB total capacity; 14.6 GiB already allocated; 360.0 MiB free; 2.0 GiB reserved)
Traceback (most recent call last):
  File "/srv/runtime/prefill.py", line 482, in prefill_chunk
    kv_cache.append(block)
  File "/srv/runtime/kvcache.py", line 130, in append
    self._allocate_for_block(size)
RuntimeError: CUDA out of memory
```
Priya M: pattern shows single long request that grew KV cache quickly (seq_len ~180k tokens estimated). Prefill keeps retrying and pushes container into OOM loop.
Alex R: node is cordoned. I'm shifting traffic from that node and will restart impacted pods one-by-one after clearing docker cache.
Marco T: adding routing rule to favor smaller-model fallback for that tenant while we triage. Pushing quick config: route.long_context_threshold=65536 -> fallback=quantized-compat.
Jill S: support - customer on account acct-204 reported failures: they saw repeated 502s and partial responses this morning. I'll draft a customer-facing note once we confirm mitigation.
Sam C: customer ops — please confirm whether that tenant runs extremely long transcripts. I'm opening a quick convo with their contact.
Priya M: temp mitigation applied:
- set PREFILL_MAX_TOKENS=65536 on replica set
- enabled prefill-circuit-breaker to reject requests > 200k tokens
- enabled kvcache-trim on eviction=aggressive
Command used:
```bash
kubectl -n inference set env deploy/inference-prod PREFILL_MAX_TOKENS=65536
kubectl rollout restart deploy/inference-prod
```
Alex R: restarted 2/3 pods, last one in progress. watching for restarts.
Priya M: after env change, OOMs stopped on restarted pods. One noisy pod had persistent reservation; evicted container and node-level CUDA leftover freed after restart.
Marco T: rolling routing change applied for the tenant; their long requests will hit fallback. We should monitor error-rate and latency for fallback model.
Jill S: writing short incident update for affected customers: "We experienced GPU OOMs causing restarts for a subset of requests with very large context windows. We've applied throttles and fallback routing; no data loss reported; working on permanent fixes." Sending in 15.
Sam C: customer replied — they're able to retry with smaller context for now. They asked for mitigation ETA.
Priya M: next steps:
- add stricter prefill request limits per-tenant (short term)
- audit kvcache growth patterns and add soft limits (mid term)
- investigate kernel-level fragmentation / CUDA caching behavior (long term)
Alex R: handing off to next oncall @MarcoT for monitoring window. I'm available if it flares.
Marco T: ack. I'll keep a 60m watch and escalate to runtime eng if any restart happens. Dashboard: https://console.redwood/prod/ops/incidents/3498765432
Priya M: filing an internal bug: runtime#1428 - kvcache unbounded growth on extreme prefill -> reproduce with long prompt harness.
Jill S: customer update sent, will post copy to #customer-status once Sam confirms wording. :white_check_mark:
incident-bot: Incident status changed -> mitigated. Severity downgraded to P3. Monitoring window started.
Alex R: thanks team. closing pager for now but keeping thread open for postmortem notes.
